method: Actual prototype JavaScript in Node VM with mocked DOM and blocked-storage cases; fixed test accounts only

checks.name: No saved learning role or missing session automatically signs in
Invalid and unknown credentials do not create a session or alter learning records
Valid session restores the matching account and ignores extra stored fields
Expired, excessive-future, wrong-account and unknown-role sessions are removed
Broken session JSON is discarded without falsely claiming storage is unavailable
Blocked session reads leave login usable and never infer authentication from saved data
Blocked session writes allow the current tab and explain that reload needs login
Logout clears authentication and private panels while retaining all learning records
Logout can invalidate a session when removal is blocked but replacement is available
Complete session-storage failure still signs out in memory with an actionable message
Expired in-memory session returns to login on the next render
Student cannot use teacher export, reset, page navigation or parent-print handlers
Previously bound teacher actions cannot run after signing out and signing in as student
Host learning updates cannot switch the signed-in student to teacher
Host learning updates never authenticate a signed-out visitor
Login credentials are absent from learning state, host exports and the session schema
